source.quote: We expect this to generate average annual net operating income of approximately $25,000,000, representing highly visible contracted cash flows with an investment-grade counterparty.

As a result of this phased delivery, we anticipate exiting 2026 with an annualized operating lease revenue run rate of $37.8 million, scaling to a run rate of $55.6 million as we exit 2027 and AMD's full 50 megawatt footprint comes online.

Across Corsicana and Rockdale, we expect total project capital of approximately $7.6 billion-$7.8 billion, $5.5 billion at Corsicana and $2.1 billion-$2.3 billion at Rockdale, with additional AMD CapEx expected to be financed through the AMD bank facility we are now finalizing.
